newsitem.title: FINLAND: Salomon says cut Kemira to underperform.
newsitem.headline: Salomon says cut Kemira to underperform.

text.p: A profit warning by Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy prompted Salomon Brothers to cut its recommendation on the stock to underperform from hold, Salomon said in a research note dated April 24 and received on Monday.
"Following a poorer than expected first quarter for fertilisers, Kemira issued a profit warning," Salomon noted.
Kemira said on April 22 that it expected first-tertial earnings to be below the year-ago period, but that the full-year 1997 result would be almost at last year's level.
"We believe Kemira's share price is vulnerable. With a new 12 month target price of 50 markka, we rate the stock underperform," it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
